thread:
Lina: hi team — married abroad and trying to add my husband to benefits. ceremony 2024-04-05, planned coverage 5/1. consulate delayed visa stamping. i have marriage cert, consulate receipt, and passport scan. can we start enrollment now and do retro to 5/1 if needed?

Tom: hey @Lina 30 you can start with provisional docs. carriers require the stamped passport for final enrollment but we can begin the QLE with marriage cert + consulate/USCIS receipt + passport copy. Retro back to 5/1 is usually possible if docs support it and you submit within the QLE window.

Lina: thanks. worried about premium catch-up. would rather split any retro deductions. is that doable?

Sam: we can split the retro premium across two payroll cycles if requested before payroll cutoff. if you need a longer plan due to hardship, fill the "retro payment plan" form in the portal within 3 business days of approval.

benefits-bot: Upload reminder: please use the secure People Ops portal (pinned in #people-ops). Suggested filenames: dependent_docs/<lastname>_spouse_<doctype>_<yyyymmdd>.pdf. Reply "uploaded" after you add files.

Lina: uploaded files: dependent_docs/Kaur_spouse_passport_marriage_20240612.pdf and consulate_receipt_20240612.pdf.

payroll-bot: Automated note: if payroll needs to split retro premium, reply with "split-2" or "split-3" before cutoff (next business day at 2pm PT).

Tom: got the upload. please post spouse full legal name + DOB here so we can prefill carrier forms and submit the QLE. we'll request retro effective 2024-05-01 pending final stamped passport.

Lina: Rajiv Singh Kaur, DOB 1991-09-17. i'll post the stamped passport scan once stamp is received (est mid-june). thanks!

Sam: noted. we'll proceed provisionally and request payroll to split deductions across two cycles per your preference — confirm by replying "split-2" to payroll-bot if you want that. Benefits will confirm final carrier enrollment within 2 business days after we receive the stamped passport.
